---
title: "Analyzing US Births"
author: "Kiara Hill"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
library(learnr2)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
births <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx")
glimpse(births)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
births_tibble <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |>
  mutate(day_of_week = factor(
    day_of_week,
    levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
    ordered = TRUE
  ))
```

```{r}
average_births_by_date <- births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarise(mean_births = mean(births), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
ggplot(average_births_by_date, aes(
  x = date_of_month,
  y = factor(month, levels = 12:1),
  fill = mean_births
)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = rev(month.name)) +
  labs(
    x = "Day of month",
    y = "Month",
    fill = "Mean births"
  )
```

```{r}
christmas_births <- births_tibble |>
  filter(month == 12) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    births_on_christmas = births[date_of_month == 25],
    day_of_week = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25],
    surrounding_day_average = mean(births[date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 27:30)]),
    pct_of_baseline = births_on_christmas /
      surrounding_day_average * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

christmas_births
```

```{r}
ggplot(christmas_births, aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = day_of_week)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Christmas births (% of surrounding-day average)",
    color = "Weekday"
  )
```

```{r}
births_model <- lm(births ~ year + factor(month) + day_of_week, data = births_tibble)
summary(births_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(pct_resid = resid(births_model) / mean(births) * 100)

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarise(mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(calendar_date = as.Date(paste(2001, month, date_of_month, sep = "-")))

calendar_resid
```

```{r}
holiday_labels <- calendar_resid |>
  filter(calendar_date %in% as.Date(c(
    "2001-01-01", "2001-07-04", "2001-12-24", "2001-12-25"
  ))) |>
  mutate(
    holiday = case_when(
      month == 1 ~ "New Year's Day",
      month == 7 ~ "Independence Day",
      date_of_month == 24 ~ "Christmas Eve",
      TRUE ~ "Christmas"
    ),
    label_date = calendar_date + case_when(
      month == 1 ~ 7,
      month == 7 ~ 7,
      date_of_month == 24 ~ -6,
      TRUE ~ 4
    ),
    label_y = case_when(
      month == 1 ~ -30,
      month == 7 ~ -33,
      date_of_month == 24 ~ -31,
      TRUE ~ -42
    )
  )

ggplot(calendar_resid, aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray50", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_segment(
    data = holiday_labels,
    aes(
      x = calendar_date,
      y = mean_pct_resid,
      xend = label_date,
      yend = label_y
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "gray40"
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = holiday_labels,
    aes(x = label_date, y = label_y, label = holiday),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Calendar date",
    y = "Mean birth-count residual (% of overall mean)"
  )
```
